spec: docs/WP12_SPECIFICATION.md Phase 4 (4.1 item 1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4); experiment E1 of docs/reports/WP12_PHASE4_XHIGH_REVIEW.md (81a9626) section 6, with the exit-ligament rule of its section 3.3
declared: 2026-10-31 (KST). Written before any formal E1 row ran. Only rows labelled DEV (artifacts/wp12/phase4_e1_dev_NNN) ran before; they are development smoke checks, never evidence. The orchestrator commits it before the formal matrix. A change after the commit is a new protocol version; failed rows are kept and reported, never rescored or silently rerun.
purpose: Decisive flat-board experiment for class (a) (oblique exit). Measure where the UNCHANGED law 8 stops separating oblique through-cuts on blade_master_flat_board_v1 (Option A: the edge ends on the solid board top), how a raised edge changes it, whether the explicit 8 mm slotted variant (Option D) separates the same obliques, and whether each oblique is kinematically reachable. Offline, it also scores what two candidate exit rules WOULD label on the recorded law-8 trajectories. No law code exists or is written for this experiment; decision D1 (review section 6) is taken afterwards at xhigh, not by this protocol.
frozen_and_unchanged: tlmpm_v5.py (law 8 and every law-4/5/8 parameter as the solver computes them; nothing is overridden), tlmpm.py, tlmpm_v2.py, tlmpm_v4.py
final_v4, every v1-v4 and goal threshold, the WP-11 records, the Phase 4a records and figures
blade_master_flat_board_v1 and the two scene files configs/wp12/scenes/bar_flat_board.json and bar_flat_board_slotted.json (read; only solver.max_cuts is set to 1 in memory, see setup.scene_override)

runner.physics: scripts/run_wp12_phase4_e1.py (one row per process; refuses row ids not declared here unless --dev; records protocol_sha256, runner_sha256 and the sha256 of tlmpm_v5.py, cut_diagnostics.py and exit_candidates.py in every result.json; never overwrites an output directory)
runner.queue: scripts/run_wp12_phase4_e1_queue.py (declared order; at most 2 concurrent jobs; per-job device; skips rows whose directory exists; GNU time per job in artifacts/wp12/logs/)
runner.reachability: scripts/preflight_wp12_phase4_e1.py (CPU, .venv; motion_preflight.MotionChecker on the compiled scene)
runner.evaluator: src/robotic_cutting_sim/exit_candidates.py exit_candidates_v1 (read-only shadow evaluator; CPU tests tests/test_exit_candidates.py)
runner.python: .venv/bin/python (Warp 1.17.0, CUDA graph per control step); TMPDIR=/mnt/data/ningan/tmp

scope: Kinematic ideal tracking of the knife edge (no robot dynamics, PhysX or cameras in the physics rows). Provisional, uncalibrated material. One deterministic setup per row, seed 42; no claim beyond the declared cases. Reachability is geometric (IK + collision preflight) and is reported as 'reachable', never as validated cutting.

setup.solver: tlmpm_v5, cutting_law 8, slots_per_node 8, max_cuts 1 (one cut digit)
setup.material: cutting_tasks_v1 via scene_config.compile_task: density 1500 kg/m^3, E 50 kPa, nu 0.3, yield 1 kPa, hardening 0, friction 0.3, G_c 0.05 J/m^2 (provisional_uncalibrated); TLMPMConfig defaults otherwise (pic 0.05, contact_stiffness 0.1, particle_contact_stiffness 0.05, contact_radius_scale 0.9, sharpness 0.8), gravity -9.81 m/s^2 z
setup.workpiece: the standard CUT-01-R bar, 160 x 30 x 20 mm (96,000 particles), bottom on the board top (workpiece-local z = 0)

supports.bar_flat_board: one solid board box 360 x 190 x 20 mm (local centre (0, 30, -10) mm), table plane at local z = -20 mm; the TLMPM fixture boxes come from compile_task (same source as the PhysX collider)
supports.bar_flat_board_slotted: explicit slotted variant (Option D, opt-in): the same board with four 8 mm wide, 8 mm deep through-width grooves at local x = -48, -16, +16, +48 mm (base slab + five top segments). E1.2 uses the +16 mm groove (x 12..20 mm).

setup.scene_override: solver.max_cuts 4 -> 1 in memory before compile_task (scene_id suffix '_e1_k1'); nothing else is changed and no file is written
setup.tool: ruler_knife_v2_y: 120 mm edge (half width 60 mm, 120 edge segments of 1 mm), TLMPM blade cross-section polygon (40 mm deep, 1.5 mm thick, double bevel 25 deg), handle box as the blunt obstacle (LiveCuttingMaterial default for profile tasks)
setup.runtime: LiveCuttingMaterial (as KinematicCuttingBackend.reset builds it: CouplingConfig(control_dt 0.02, material_dt 1e-4, dx 0.004), cutting_law 8, solver tlmpm_v5) driven by explicit world edge poses, one advance() per 20 ms control step (constant twist interpolation, one CUDA graph per control step). cut_index 0 while ARMED, cutting=False otherwise.
setup.recorders: cut_diagnostics_v1 (read-only, inside the graph: before_step/after_step) and exit_candidates_v1 (read-only shadow evaluator after it). Neither writes a solver array; bitwise neutrality is a CPU test (tests/test_cut_diagnostics.py, tests/test_exit_candidates.py).
setup.devices: cuda:0 and cuda:1 are both shared with other users; nvidia-smi is checked before each launch; at most 2 E1 jobs at once; processes of others are never stopped. A row's device is recorded; device is not a science variable (repeats A_p20_rep2 and A_p35_rep2 set the GPU nondeterminism band).
setup.worktree: The repository working tree is shared with other agents and may be dirty in files E1 does not import. Each result records git HEAD, git status --porcelain and the sha256 of every E1-relevant source; rows are comparable only if those hashes agree.

geometry.frame: Edge frame columns (d, e, n) in workpiece-local coordinates: advance d = (-sin tau, 0, -cos tau), edge line e = (0, 1, 0), blade normal n = d x e = (cos tau, 0, -sin tau). tau is the tilt of the blade (and of the cut plane) about the edge line (+y); tau = 0 is the vertical sever (= goal_planner.through_cut_rotation([1, 0, 0])). -tau mirrors the cut about x = x0. Round-2 OBLIQUE_W and Phase 4a sweep convention; s = (x - o).n, f = (x - edge).d.
geometry.plane: The cut plane contains the edge line and d and meets the board top (z = 0) at x = x0 (plane_x0_mm): o = (x0, 0, 0).
geometry.edge_path: Edge positions o + t d. ARMED from t_start = -(20 mm / cos tau) - 8 mm (8 mm along d before the section top, the goal planner's cut clearance) to t_end = -edge_end_z / cos tau, at 10 mm/s along d (goal planner cut speed). edge_end_z_mm is the local z of the edge line (= the blade's lowest point: the edge vertex is the lowest polygon vertex for |tau| < 77.5 deg; checked per row) at the end of the stroke: 0 for Option A (h = 0), h for raised rows, -overtravel*cos tau for slotted rows.
phases: SETTLE 0.5 s: disarmed, edge parked at the armed start (no contact)
CUT: ARMED, constant 10 mm/s along d from start to end (the last control step is shorter so the end is exact)
HOLD 0.3 s: disarmed at the end pose (goal planner hold)
WITHDRAW: disarmed, 20 mm/s along -d back to the start
SETTLE_END 0.5 s: disarmed at the start
geometry.slotted_rule: Two overtravel levels per slotted tilt, both computed before any formal run (DEV, artifacts/wp12/phase4_e1_dev_001). groove_limit: the largest t_end for which the region swept by the TLMPM blade polygon (convex hull of the start and end poses; the edge line is horizontal so y does not matter) keeps >= 1.0 mm from every board box (the C2 free-space blade-fixture clearance; the groove floor binds at 0-30 deg, the walls at 35 deg), with x0 chosen to maximise the wall clearance at that overtravel (rounded to 0.05 mm, overtravel then floored to 0.001 mm). reach_limit: with the same x0, the largest overtravel (bisection, floored to 0.01 mm) for which the full E1.3 motion preflight passes; at 20-35 deg the binding check is knife_handle_clearance (5 mm) of the handle against the board top, so the reachable overtravel is 6.67 / 5.35 / 3.87 / 2.19 mm at 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 deg against the groove limit 7.45-8.46 mm. The runner recomputes the swept-blade clearance and marks a row FAIL_INTEGRITY below 1.0 mm. The edge stays above the action-workspace floor (local z >= -8 mm for the slotted board).
geometry.option_A_rule: The edge's lowest point ends exactly on the solid board top (h = 0) or h above it; the rigid board is never entered (blade-board overlap is computed and reported per row; any overlap > 1e-9 m fails the row's integrity check).

row_list_reconciliation: The orchestrator's list and the review's E1.1 list differ; this protocol runs their union: tau in {0,1,2,3,5,10,15,20,25,30,35} and all negative mirrors {-1,...,-35} (the review listed -5, -20, -35); raised h in {0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} mm at tau in {5, 20, 35} (the review listed 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 1.0; the orchestrator 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0); slotted tau in {20, 25, 30, 35} plus the 0 deg control; two repeats. After the DEV preflight, four reach-limited slotted rows (D_p20_reach ... D_p35_reach) were added before the protocol was committed.

metrics.topology: Law-8 mechanical components on the reference stencil (cut_topology.mechanical_components_packed, the WP-11 rule) at the end of CUT and at the FINAL state (codes change only while armed, so they agree); piece mass fractions; pieces = components with >= 1% of the mass.
metrics.bridges: Direct code-0 bridges (cut_diagnostics.direct_bridges = law8_validation.bridge_report rule): count, s / f / reference z ranges, layer counts.
metrics.unlabelled_by_failing_condition: Digit-0 particles within |s_ref| <= 12 mm of the plane: count; cut_diagnostics.classify_unassigned classes; first-failing and only-failing law-4 band condition totals (REASONS); in-core count (|s| <= dx = 4 mm); ahead of the final edge in reference and final positions; s range; reference layers.
metrics.exit_face_assignment: Bottom four reference layers (z_ref < 4 mm) within |s_ref| <= 12 mm, per layer and per side (s < 0 uphill for tau > 0; s >= 0): counts of digit 0 / 1 / 2, labels disagreeing with the plane side for |s| > 2 mm, and the law-4 rule that labelled them (band / lead).
metrics.edge_to_board_clearance: Edge lowest point at the end of CUT minus the board top (mm); lowest blade vertex index; minimum signed distance of the swept blade region to the board boxes (mm, geometric); blade-board overlap depth (must be 0).
metrics.board_penetration: Material particle centres inside board boxes (max over steps, final), minimum particle signed distance to the boxes, particles below the board top (slotted: these may hang into the groove, which is not penetration), solver max fixture penetration statistic.
metrics.candidate_rules_offline: For each candidate ('proposed' = rejected breakthrough-gated lead of the Phase 4a draft; 'exit_ligament' = L9-EL of review section 3.3): shadow labels (count, side, s and f at assignment, substep), labels the later law-8 band gave a different side, predicted codes (shadow digit where the candidate labelled first, else the law-8 digit), predicted components and pieces, remaining direct bridges. Proposed B_k: fraction of material segments with B_k = 1 at the last armed moving control step (material segment = >= 1 particle within the edge width, the reviewer's definition) and the substep series; L9-EL: seen / X / ligament segment counts per substep and the first X substep. Both use the relative swept-normal fallback (review section 4); substeps where it differs from the solver's are counted.
metrics.reachability: E1.3: per row, IK chain from the workcell HOME (runtime Newton IK) plus the C2 collision check (motion_preflight.MotionChecker.check_joint_path) over HOME -> REORIENT/APPROACH (30 mm above the armed start along -d) -> PRE_CUT -> CUT -> HOLD -> WITHDRAW -> LIFT, <= 2 mm / 1 deg samples; status PASS/FAIL, binding check and slack, IK worst errors, joint margin. Reported as 'kinematically reachable' (or not), never as validated cutting. Declared reading of a contact tie: at h = 0 the blade-board rule is distance >= 0 with the edge planned exactly on the board top, so sub-micrometre IK residuals decide it (DEV: A_p35 -0.23 um FAIL, A_p00 +0.29 um PASS). The checker's status is reported unchanged; a row whose ONLY failing check is blade-board with |slack| < 1 um is additionally flagged TIE_AT_CONTACT (not reclassified).
metrics.dynamics_context: Peak blade reaction, max tool penetration, min det F, bottom-layer mean z displacement per side, max particle speed at the end (reported only).

outcome_labels.SEPARATED: law-8 components >= 2 with two pieces >= 1% each and 0 direct bridges at FINAL
outcome_labels.row_status: PASS = the row ran to completion, recorders report no overflow and the integrity checks hold (no blade-board overlap, slotted clearance >= 1 mm, no slot overflow); FAIL_INTEGRITY otherwise; ERROR = crashed. A row's outcome label is a measurement, not a pass/fail of law 8.

declared_predictions.source: REVIEWER predictions from WP12_PHASE4_XHIGH_REVIEW.md section 6 (E1.1, E1.2) and section 2 (reviewer CPU probe on a 40 x 12 x 12 mm bar, which is a prediction, not a result). They are scored and reported, not used to pass or fail any row.
declared_predictions.P1_E1.1_onset: Law 8 on Option A fails (stays connected) from 5-10 deg (margin) and robustly from 15-20 deg.
declared_predictions.P2_E1.1_proposed_B_k: The proposed B_k stays 0 on >= 40% of material segments at the end for tau >= 20 deg (>= 75% at 30-35 deg).
declared_predictions.P3_E1.2_slotted: Option D (8 mm groove) separates at 20, 25, 30, 35 deg at the largest overtravel the groove allows (review: 'at the largest overtravel the 8 mm groove allows'). No declared prediction for the reach-limited rows (2.19-6.67 mm); for reference, the Phase 4a 30 mm relief-slot sweep separated 35 deg at >= 6 mm and failed at 4 mm, and the reviewer's geometric model says that without sag 1-2 mm of overtravel separates under law 8.
declared_predictions.P4_mirror: Negative tilts mirror the positive rows (same outcome; counts equal within the repeat band).
declared_predictions.P5_static_probe_candidates: Reviewer static relabel on the CPU probe: the proposed rule gives 2 components only at 5 deg (1 at 10-35 deg); the exit-ligament rule gives 2 at 0-20 and 30-35 deg (25 deg a static-test margin). On E1 this is checked with the per-substep shadow evaluator (offline).
declared_predictions.P6_tau0: tau = 0, h = 0 separates (it equals the Phase 2 S_000 through-cut setup on the workcell board) and both candidates predict the law-8 topology.
declared_predictions.not_predicted: Raised-edge rows have no declared prediction for law 8 at tau > 0 (Phase 2 at tau = 0: h <= 0.375 mm separates, h >= 0.5 mm leaves a layer-0 bridge). Reachability has no declared prediction (flat-board reachability is unmeasured; WP11_PHASE_E_ROUND2.md:237 reports 5.6-6.1 mm handle-clearance slack at +-30-35 deg on wp11_workcell_v1).

budget.estimate_per_row: about 290-340 control steps (5.8-6.8 s simulated); DEV measured 1.37 s per control step for the full bar on a shared RTX 5090 with both recorders, so 6.5-8 min per row
budget.concurrency: at most 2 E1 jobs at once over cuda:0 and cuda:1 (shared)
budget.stop_rule: If the budget is exhausted, the remaining rows are reported NOT_RUN; no row is dropped silently. A crashed row is preserved and may be rerun once under '<id>_rerun1' with the reason recorded.

outputs.formal: artifacts/wp12/phase4_e1_NNN/<row id>/ (result.json, steps.jsonl, snapshots.npz, diag.npz); NNN is the next free number (001 first); never overwritten
outputs.report: 'E1 results' section appended to docs/reports/WP12_CUTTING_PHYSICS.md (data only; D1 is decided at xhigh)

not_in_scope: any law-9 code, any change to tlmpm_v5 or to law-8 parameters
the (e) swept-normal fallback variant (shipped separately; E1's evaluator uses the relative fallback only offline)
